evidence.title: Charter secures $34.5bn Cox merger, completes Liberty Broadband acquisition

summary: Charter Communications announced the completion of its $34.5 billion merger with Cox Communications, consolidating two major cable operators. The transaction also includes Charter's acquisition of Liberty Broadband's stake, expanding its broadband footprint and strengthening its position in the U.S. telecom market.
title: Charter Communications Finalizes $34.5 Billion Merger with Cox and Acquires Liberty Broadband Assets
